shots.focal_element: Presenter seated at a wooden desk facing camera, a tablet laid flat on the desk in the foreground
shots.what_happens: Short (about 1.6 s) frontal medium shot: the presenter says 'Let's take a look' (w108-w111) with open-palm gestures, then looks down and reaches toward the tablet on the desk, motivating the cut to the overhead UI shot. A small white HubSpot sprocket logo bug sits top right.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a locked-off frontal medium shot of the presenter for the 'let's take a look' line and end the clip on his hand moving toward the desk tablet so the next overhead UI shot reads as his point of view.

shots.shot_type_other: overhead live-action shot of a tablet lying on a desk showing the product UI, with a real hand tapping it
shots.focal_element: A 'Contact Us' web form inside a browser window on the tablet screen, centred on a wooden desk
on_screen_text: We'd love to hear from you! Please fill out the form, and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.
shots.typography: In-product UI type: 'Contact Us' as a bold serif-style heading in title case; body copy and field labels in a small regular geometric sans, sentence case, default tracking; 'Submit' in a small bold sans on a filled button. Browser chrome text is too small to read on the contact sheet.
shots.what_happens: Locked-off top-down shot of a tablet on a wooden desk. A hand taps the email field (around 36.0 s); the form, which initially shows several fields (email plus name and company-type rows), collapses to just the email field with a '1 of 1' progress bar and Submit button as the VO says Breeze Intelligence will auto-populate the data it has (w121-w132). Around 42.5-44.5 s a hand reaches in again and an extra field appears below the email, matching the VO about showing only a new field for missing data such as personal phone numbers (w133-w151). The exact labels of the extra field are not legible on the sheets.
shots.build_rebuild: Film or composite a top-down tablet on a desk playing a screen capture of a single-column form whose non-email fields collapse (height animate to 0) after the email is entered, then re-insert one new field below it, timed to the VO lines w121-w132 and w133-w151.

shots.focal_element: Presenter seated on the left third, angled three-quarter to camera, bright window light and soft background on the right
shots.what_happens: Second camera angle: a three-quarter side medium shot of the presenter delivering the benefit line about forms dynamically populating with rich data to understand, score and route leads (w152-w180), with small hand gestures and hands resting on the desk tablet near the end. Out-of-focus window light fills the right two thirds. HubSpot logo bug top right.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a second, off-axis camera angle with the presenter on the left third and a shallow-depth-of-field bright background on the right for the summarising benefit line, keeping the take continuous for the full sentence.

shots.shot_type_other: overhead live-action shot of a tablet lying on a desk showing the HubSpot app UI
shots.focal_element: HubSpot 'Contact Form' submissions page with a teal 'Submission details' side panel listing enriched contact and company properties
on_screen_text: This value has been populated by enrichment.
shots.typography: In-product HubSpot UI type: page title 'Contact Form' in a medium-weight sans, title case; panel header 'Submission details' in white sans on a teal bar; property labels small regular sans in sentence case with small sparkle markers on enriched fields; tooltip in small white sans on a dark slate box. Left navigation labels are readable on the keyframe but small.
shots.what_happens: Same top-down tablet framing as s006, now showing the back-office view: the Contact Form submissions list with a Submission details panel open for the submitted contact. Fingers briefly enter at the bottom edge (about 55.5-56.5 s), then a tooltip 'This value has been populated by enrichment.' appears next to an enriched field from about 57.0 s and stays while the VO says customers don't waste time and you still have all the data (w181-w206). The final sheet frame at 60.5 s already shows the frontal presenter angle, which looks like the cut into s009 landing within that sample.
shots.build_rebuild: Show the CRM record view on the same overhead tablet setup and pop a dark tooltip reading 'populated by enrichment' beside a marked field about a second into the shot, holding it static under the payoff line w181-w206.
